note: hid_row_rules.json is a byte-for-byte copy of the row-rule registry of nvs.hidden-trajectory, whose source of truth is the contract side (sensos feature/u5-hidden-trajectory). A rule is added there first, then this copy is taken again and this lock updated (DC-T2b-3). tests/test_row_rules_registry_copy.py checks the copy against this lock and against ROW_RULES.
